item.title: Rubio confirms the heresy: the U.S. went to war in Iran because of Israel
item.description: The heresy of Walt and Mearsheimer's Israel lobby theory was the claim that Israel and its supporters pushed the U.S. into war. Marco Rubio has now confirmed this analysis when he admitted that Trump went to war with Iran because of Israel.

item.title: The War to Erase October 7: What ‘The Atlantic’ leaves out about Netanyahu and the US-Israeli assault on Iran
item.description: The Atlantic's Yair Rosenberg recasts Benjamin Netanyahu as a tragic figure forced to take radical action after October 7, ignoring his long history of fomenting war and exploiting Jewish trauma to further himself and his Zionist ideology.

item.title: It’s time for America to break up with Israel
item.description: No matter how desperately our politicians try to convince us otherwise, Israel isn't good for us. The new U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, which Americans overwhelmingly do not want, is the latest proof of that. It's time for us to end the relationship.

item.title: Debunking the lies of the Iran War
item.description: The U.S.-Israeli war on Iran has been built on lies. Here is the truth about Iran's nuclear weapons program, the claim that Iran was an imminent threat, and the lie that Trump has a plan for what happens next.

item.title: Palestinians in Gaza fear famine returning as Israel cuts off food amid Iran war
item.description: Once Israel and the U.S. launched their war on Iran, Israel closed the crossings into Gaza and cut off all aid. Palestinians in the Strip now fear a return to famine amid food shortages and soaring prices.

item.title: Lies, distortions, and propaganda: how the U.S. mainstream media coverage on Iran hides the truth
item.description: Even those familiar with the biased U.S. mainstream coverage of the Middle East are shocked at how bad the reporting on the U.S.-Israel war on Iran has been.

item.title: Is AIPAC headed for another own goal in Illinois?
item.description: Israel is emerging as a central theme in the upcoming midterms, with one of the clearest examples being Illinois's 9th district Democratic primary.

item.title: Israel is using the ‘Gaza doctrine’ in Lebanon and Iran
item.description: For years, Israel used the “Dahiya doctrine” in Gaza. Now it’s using the “Gaza doctrine” in Dahiya — and Tehran.

item.title: The war on Iran is forcing Gulf states to reconsider regional strategy as the U.S. and Israel lead the region into uncertainty
item.description: Iran’s retaliatory attacks on its neighbors, and the U.S. failure to plan for them, are forcing the Gulf Cooperation Council states to reconsider their regional strategies and their relationship with Washington.

item.title: Millions at risk of displacement as Israel bombards Lebanon
item.description: After 15 months of a fragile ceasefire, Lebanon woke up on March 2 to the familiar sounds of Israeli bombs. As the violence escalates and tens of thousands are displaced, Lebanon’s social divisions threaten to worsen an already dire situation.
